## Names

<a id="protection_key"></a>
### [`protection_key`](../../../src/actor_room_tables.asm#L6) `$1166`

*variable*

Copy-protection key: $0CD5 stores $CF79 XOR $CF99 here (bytes read from the disk protection). play_sound_80_checked sabotages the game when it is 0.

- **Read by:** [`play_sound_80_checked`](actor_movement.md#play_sound_80_checked) [`$1FCE`](../../../src/actor_movement.asm#L539)
- **Written by:** [`spawn_yamo`](actors.md#spawn_yamo) [`$0CDE`](../../../src/actors.asm#L183)

<a id="actor_frame_addr_lo"></a>
### [`actor_frame_addr_lo`](../../../src/actor_room_tables.asm#L9) `$1167-$1238`

*data*

Low bytes of 210 addresses of 96-byte actor graphics frames (three 32-byte columns) that $512F builds at init in $9000-$9FBF and $C000-$CADF. Odd entries name the overlay frame: $CAE0 is the scratch frame ORed onto the even frame before it, high byte 0 means no overlay.

- **Referred to by:** [`build_collision_masks`](collision.md#build_collision_masks) [`$515D`](../../../src/collision.asm#L46), [`build_frame_mask`](collision.md#build_frame_mask) [`$5193`](../../../src/collision.asm#L74), [`actor_background_collision`](collision.md#actor_background_collision) [`$5239`](../../../src/collision.asm#L172)

### [`actor_frame_addr_hi`](../../../src/actor_room_tables.asm#L38) `$1239-$130A`

<a id="yamo_entry_preference"></a>
### [`yamo_entry_preference`](../../../src/actor_room_tables.asm#L94) `$136F-$1382`

*data*

Per room (20 bytes): 0 = random spawn point; positive = 3 times out of 4 spawn point A (room_spawn_x/y); negative = 3 times out of 4 spawn point B (room_alt_spawn_x/y). The Ninja also uses this sign when its ninja_entry_preference is non-zero.

- **Referred to by:** [`init_actor`](actors.md#init_actor) [`$0C04`](../../../src/actors.asm#L67), [`init_actor`](actors.md#init_actor) [`$0C10`](../../../src/actors.asm#L72), [`init_actor`](actors.md#init_actor) [`$0C38`](../../../src/actors.asm#L93)

<a id="joy_handedness_p1"></a>
### [`joy_handedness_p1`](../../../src/actor_room_tables.asm#L99) `$1383`

*variable*

Joystick mode of port 1: nonzero = normal, 0 = left-handed (directions turned a quarter turn through joystick_rotate_bits). L on the title sets 0, R sets 1. read_joysticks indexes it by the player whose port it reads (player 1 = port 1).

- **Read by:** [`game_frame_update`](frame_update.md#game_frame_update) [`$15EE`](../../../src/frame_update.asm#L43)

<a id="joy_handedness_p2"></a>
### [`joy_handedness_p2`](../../../src/actor_room_tables.asm#L102) `$1384`

*variable*

Joystick mode of port 2, same format as joy_handedness_p1. Shift-L on the title sets 0, Shift-R sets 1.

- **Read by:** [`game_frame_update`](frame_update.md#game_frame_update) [`$1606`](../../../src/frame_update.asm#L57)
